topic: Animal Body Parts and Their Functions
key_concepts: Animals have different body parts depending on their kind
Body parts help animals move, eat, swim, breathe, and protect themselves
Beak, teeth, mouth, and tongue are used for getting food
Horns and tail are used for protection from other animals
Feet are used for running, jumping, and walking
Fins and tail are used for swimming
Fish use gills to breathe underwater
Frogs use their legs for jumping to escape bigger animals
Carabao, cow, and goat have horns and tail for protection
Horse and carabao both have tails
Chicken uses its beak for eating
